subject: TYPE clause
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 13.18.57.4 'that BASED clause applies and any BASED clause specified in the description of type-name-1 is ignored for this entry' -> OK §13.18.57.4 4)). The subject's own BASED is set at BindEntry; the one description copy ORs the template's in (`to.IsBased |= from.IsBased`, DescriptionCopyKind.EntryOnly - kb/Work PB1300), and since both clauses mean 'based' the result is the subject's clause applying with the template's ignored; l1c34_type_subject_based pins 'applies' (V TYPE T BASED over a non-based T is based). The complementary case (no own BASED over a BASED template) is GR1's and is pinned on GR-13.18.57.4-1.
